title: Random mouse pos after dragging an inspector value
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 
v4.7.beta1.official [1c8cc9e7e]
v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935]

### System information

Godot v4.7.beta1 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

The mouse pointer randomly jumps to one of two places after dragging left or right on a value in the inspector.

1. If the inspector value doesn't have a slider, ex: position x
Dragging left or right and releasing the mouse button, jumps the mouse pointer to either:
- expected: the drag start position
- issue: the center of the viewport

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/74ebb972-1192-48fc-bfc2-46f2c55abf9f

2. If the inspector value has both a number and a slider, ex: rotation
Dragging left or right on the number and releasing the mouse button, jumps the mouse pointer to either:
- issue: the rotation sliders drag handle
- issue: the center of the viewport

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2bb9c10b-f014-44a1-8421-9fbda2a2eba5

Expected:
Show the mouse pointer where the drag started on the number, like it sometimes does when dragging a number without a slider.

### Steps to reproduce

- open the project: [mouse-jumps-when-dragging-inspector-value.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27102993/mouse-jumps-when-dragging-inspector-value.zip)
- in the scene panel
- select: Node2D
- in the inspector panel
- unfold the transform properties
- drag left or right on the value for Position x
- the mouse pointer disappears and the value updates while dragging
- release the mouse button

Expected:
The mouse pointer should appear where the drag started.
This happens sometimes.

Issue:
Sometimes the mouse pointer appears in the center of the viewport, and it has to be moved back to the inspector panel to be able to drag again.

A related mouse jump issue occurs when dragging on the number on an inspector value that has both a number and a slider, ex. Rotation

Here the mouse pointer never jumps back to the drag start position on the number, instead it jumps to either:
- the slider handle below the number
- or to the center of the viewport

If one wants to fine-tune the rotation by dragging a second or more times. Then the mouse has to be moved back to the number before starting to drag again. Because the value changes at two different speeds when dragging on the:
- number
- slider handle

In this video, the mouse is physically moved the same amount left and right while dragging.
- on the number, it moves from about:  -10, to: 30
- on the slider handle, it moves from about: -90, to: 130


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6a2312b1-7ef6-4e50-bdd7-64e9502279eb


If the mouse pointer returned to the drag start position on the number, then one could keep looking at the rotating object in the viewport, while releasing the mouse button and pressing it again to fine-tune the rotation.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mouse-jumps-when-dragging-inspector-value.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27102993/mouse-jumps-when-dragging-inspector-value.zip)
